resources.string: Idle. Tap Start, grant screen-capture consent, then open any app with English text and tap 🔊.
Grant "Display over other apps" so the floating button can appear.
Use Koko voice in any app (TTS engine)
Recommended: tap the button above, pick KokoReader as preferred TTS engine — then Kindle Read Aloud and any app speak with the Koko voice, no overlay needed.
